scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run test:build-config && pnpm run test:policy-quality && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.test:browser-regression: playwright test --config=playwright.config.ts && playwright test --config=playwright.uat.config.ts && playwright test --config=playwright.workforce-insights.config.ts && playwright test --config=playwright.intake-conversion.config.ts
scripts.validate:release: pnpm run test:build-config && pnpm run test:policy-quality && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test:browser-regression && pnpm --filter @workspace/onboarding-agent test
scripts.test:deployment-build: env -u PORT -u BASE_PATH CI=true NODE_ENV=production pnpm run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
